questions.question: From where does David call to God in Psalm 61?
options: From the depths of the sea, when the waters rise
From the gate of the city, when enemies press in
From the height of the mountain, when the storm breaks
From the end of the earth, when his heart is faint
questions.answer: From the end of the earth, when his heart is faint

questions.question: To what does David ask to be led?
options: The shelter that hides him from the storm
The rock that is higher than he
The fortress that no army can take
The tower that stands above the plain
questions.answer: The rock that is higher than he

questions.question: David longs to dwell in God's tent forever and take refuge under the shelter of his wings.
Lead me to the _____ that is higher than I.
For you, O God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your _____.
